I am writing to refer this patient under the skin suspected cancer pathway. She has two separate concerns meeting NICE NG12 criteria.

First, a skin lesion on her right shin present for eight weeks with changes in size (growing from 4mm to 8mm) and changes in colour (increasingly uneven pigmentation). On examination: asymmetry and irregular border.

Second, an area of ulceration on her left forearm that has failed to heal over the same eight-week period despite topical treatment. No improvement in the ulceration.

Moderate cumulative sun exposure over her lifetime. No previous skin cancer. No family history of melanoma.
